name: BBC iPlayer UHD — AS-11 X1 / IMF (TSP2121-1)

frame_rate.notes: 2160p/25 or 2160p/50, progressive only (BBC File v5.1.0 §1.1.1). Frame rate must be agreed with the broadcaster before shooting.

color.notes: ITU-R BT.2100, YCbCr only, narrow (limited) range. Commissioned programmes must normally be delivered as HLG HDR (BBC File v5.1.0 §1.3, §5.1.2); PQ is permitted only by prior agreement with the broadcaster. HLG carries no mastering-display static metadata and is legacy-display compatible, so no HDR metadata or SDR fallback is required for delivery. Chroma is sub-sampled 4:2:0 or 4:2:2 — programmes normally deliver as 4:2:0; 4:2:2 only where the broadcaster requires it (BBC File v5.1.0 §1.1.1). Line-up: EBU Tech 3373 HLG 6 Bars (the DPP UHD line-up signal).

layout.notes: AS-11 X1 DPP UHD 'Audio Layout Mode 1' — SMPTE ST 2067-8 Multichannel Audio (MCA) labelling, Default Audio Layout 'A'. Both mixes are MANDATORY and must appear in this order: Sound Track 1 = Stereo Main Mix (L, R); Sound Track 2 = Surround Main Mix 5.1 (L, R, C, LFE, Ls, Rs), English. Up to 128 sound tracks / channels; additional Alternative / M&E / Audio-Description tracks by prior agreement. Exactly one Dolby Audio Metadata Bitstream must be embedded, accurate for all 5.1 sound tracks. Uncompressed PCM mapped with SMPTE ST 382.

loudness.notes: EBU R128 (EBU Tech 3343). Programme Loudness -23.0 LUFS ±0.5 LU (non-live); ±1.0 LU for live / as-live. Maximum true peak: recommended not to exceed -3 dBTP; content FAILS above -1 dBTP. Loudness Range (LRA) is guidance only, not a hard gate.

luminance.tolerance_note: 10-bit UHD (BBC File v5.1.0 §1.4): nominal/data range 64-940; preferred/gamut band 20-984; total 4-1019 (clipped beyond). Out-of-gamut is an error only after exceeding 1% of integrated active-image area (EBU R103).

governance.source: AMWA AS-11 X1 (https://amwa-tv.github.io/AS-11_X1/AMWA_AS_11_X1.html) + BBC Technical Delivery Standards (File) v5.1.0, 2020 — UHD / iPlayer delivery: §1.3 ITU-R BT.2100 UHD, §2.2 loudness, §4.7 Audio Channel Allocations AS-11 DPP X1, §5.1 UHD Files. Based on UK DPP File v5.0.2 (2020).
governance.notes: BBC UHD delivery to iPlayer is a SEPARATE path from AS-11 UK DPP HD (see bbc_hd / dpp_uk_hd): the UHD programme delivers as a SMPTE TSP2121-1 (IMF) package / AMWA AS-11 X1, AND an AS-11 HD version must ALSO be delivered via the standard AS-11 delivery portal. Video: AVC / H.264, 3840x2160 16:9, 2160p/25 or 2160p/50 progressive, 10-bit, ITU-R BT.2100 HLG. Long-GoP or I-Frame must be agreed with the broadcaster in advance (so GOP is not hard-locked here). Minimum mean data rate (across the whole file): Long-GoP 2160p/25 = 200 Mb/s, 2160p/50 = 250 Mb/s; I-Frame 2160p/25 = 250 Mb/s, 2160p/50 = 500 Mb/s (bitrate.min is the 200 Mb/s floor; the engine treats bitrate as advisory). NB the AS-11 X1 bitrate research flagged a '2500 Mb/s' value for 2160p/50 Long-GoP as a likely typo — the BBC File v5.1.0 §5.1.1 table confirms it is 250 Mb/s. The QC read path for this profile is the UHD/HDR + IMF handling (imfcore / photonqc), NOT the AS-11 HD ffprobe path. PSE is mandatory (Ofcom guidelines, ITU-R BT.1702). Subtitles/closed captions delivered as a separate sidecar per broadcaster (IMSC / EBU-TT for the IMF package). Start timecode 10:00:00:00, continuous.
